name: Sparse Voxelization with Oracle and Parallel Scan
aliases: Sparse Voxelization via Coarse-to-Fine Oracle and Scan
definition: A parallel voxelization pipeline that uses an oracle kernel to decide voxel retention, applies a parallel prefix sum scan to culling decisions for subdivision or compaction, repeats until high resolution, and renders pixel-sized voxels as splats textured by weighted input color images.
summary: Sparse Voxelization with Oracle and Parallel Scan is a real-time, top-down technique that reconstructs 3D surfaces from image streams by iteratively refining a sparse voxel list using GPU-accelerated culling and compacting.
